profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer with over ten years of experience. I have had the chance to help clients accomplish their digital transformation goals and deliver solutions across several industries such as Automotive, Manufacturing, Insurance, Retail, Real Estate, Fitness and Finance.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and built a prototype for a custom home building web platform; in charge of architecting the delivery pipeline, cloud infrastructure, frontend and backend.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Senior full stack developer, assisting in the entire digital transformation process for our clients; from ideation and requirement gathering to delivery as well as support and maintenance.

• Worked on a web collaboration tool for financial institutions where they could communicate with one another in order to keep a master list of "bad accounts" for the benefit of the users.
• Worked on a business rule based fraud detection tool with a web portal component, the tool would take in cheque information, apply all the configurable business rules and flag suspicious activity. Users could then login to the portal review the suspicious items and take appropriate action if needed. Users with enough clearance could also modify and adjust the business rules with ease.
• Worked on a customer sentiment analysis portal tool. The tool would amalgamate all of a financial institution's interactions with a given client and classify them as negative or positive, the FI could then take corrective action for disgruntled clients or reinforce already good relationships.
• Worked on a cheque kiting detection tool, kiting is a type of fraud in which a set of circular transactions are completed with the goal of making use of non-existent funds. The system was able to ingest and analyze several cheque datasets and detect this condition.
• Worked for a luxury fitness brand creating a web tool that would allow their instructors and content administrators create and produce playlists for their virtual workout sessions.
• Worked for a self-care well-being company in their major website overhaul, my responsibilities included primarily on building the new website's integration layer that would aid in gluing together all of their systems (Auth, CMS, E-comm, CRM and ERP).
• Worked with a major Canadian retailer in their efforts to centralize their catalogue of properties and products into a CMS. Built an integration layer that would expose endpoints to apply business rules and keep data in sync.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Full stack developer, assisting in the entire digital transformation process for our clients. Worked on several projects such as:

• Worked for one of the top Insurance companies in Canada creating an application to streamline and digitize their FNOL (First Notice of Loss) form processing. The application would take in a BPMN model as input and would output an automatically generated web-accessible UI for claimants to fill.
• Worked for a multinational Fortune 500 B2B IT Services company on their internal web portal built in AEM. This company employs more than 100,000 individuals and as such the project was a massive undertaking. My role in the project consisted primarily on creating reusable frontend components for the portal.
• Worked for one of the worldwide Big Four professional services companies assisting them with maintenance and performance improvements for an internal tool used to organize their massive dataset of articles and documents. This project did not include any new features but our work allowed us to massively reduce page loading times and greatly improve the overall app performance.
• Worked on a new website for one of Canada's largest retailers, project consisted of mostly CMS work and creating reusable frontend components for the site.
• Worked for a fintech company owned by three of Canada's largest banks in several of their digital transformation initiatives.
• Helped build a fraud detection web portal, the portal would allow the company and its clients to detect and assist in the confirmation of cheque fraud in Canada.
• Worked on a duplicate cheque detection portal, the tool would take in massive datasets of cheques and detect collisions between them, collisions would then go through a web workflow where they would be reviewed and categorized so that further action could be taken if necessary.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Assisting with the analysis of client's operations, manufacturing systems and business needs.
•	Assisting with the design, development and implementation of software applications for clients.
•	Worked on Altria’s MES (Manufacturing Execution System) solution which is developed using Silverlight, VB.NET and Microsoft SQL Server. This MES solution handles work orders, inventory, equipment, quality checklists, etc. This MES system enforces all of Altria’s custom business rules and MES functionality.
•	Worked on a project to migrate Medical Pharmacies Group Limited consultant tools website which was developed using PHP, jQuery and PostgreSQL to an Angular.js, ASP.Net Web API and Microsoft SQL Server based single page application. Consultant tools is a website that allows consultants to manage their nursing home visits, perform audits and medical checks as well as accessing all of their patient’s information.
•	Worked on the development of Wonderware Enterprise Integrator 2014. We used Marionette.js, Backbone.js as well as Microsoft’s ASP.NET Web API technologies to migrate a web 1.0 application to a responsive MVC single-page application. Wonderware Enterprise Integrator is an application that allows different systems that are independent from each other to communicate between themselves and share information.
•	Worked with the Nestle team developing Nestle’s MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Library. Main responsible for development of the Material Preparation module of the library which allows operators to pre-weigh materials and create pallets needed to satisfy process orders in advance and thus make the process more efficient. Worked on the migration of Nestle’s MES Library from a Windows Forms application to a web based HTML5 application using Marionette.js, Backbone.js and ASP.NET Web API.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •	I was responsible for the design and development of the software subsystem named Hardware Micro Application Layer (HW_MAL), its function is to provide the hardware team with every Microcontroller software interface they need to test the circuitry for General Motor’s Powertrain Electric Control Units for V8 Gasoline 2015 models.

positions.title: Tools & Methods/Central Validation and Verification Intern
positions.description: •	Generation of test automation scripts in Python for validating that automotive electronic control units perform correctly and meet the required specifications. Generation of documents for the correct usage of laboratory tools. Documentation of useful and common laboratory tool’s features.

positions.title: Process Engineer Intern
positions.description: •	Development of Manufacturing Process Instructions (MPI’s). Development of process routes for new products. Product assembling. Assembly fixtures design and validation. Production line support.

positions.title: Merchandise Host
positions.description: •	Worked at the World of Disney store, during my shifts I was tasked with keeping rooms stocked as well as performing merchandise transactions.
